newsitem.title: GREECE: Athens bomb wrecks jeep of Dutch embassy worker.
newsitem.headline: Athens bomb wrecks jeep of Dutch embassy worker.

text.p: A small bomb blast wrecked the jeep of a Dutch embassy employee near the Panathinaiko stadium in central Athens on Friday but caused no injuries, police said.
A previously unknown group calling itself the "Revolutionary Front" claimed responsibility for the blast near the embassy in a telephone call to Skai television.
A caller said the attack was linked to the commemoration of the November 17, 1973, student uprising in Athens against the military junta ruling then.
"The 1973 uprising shed light on today's struggles and revolutions," the anonymous caller told Skai. Police said they had not heard of the group before.
The 1973 student uprising at the Athens Polytechnic School helped bring down the military junta ruling from 1967 to 1974.
